candidate_under_audit.test_contract: circular-block bootstrap of the centered negative-reversion score

analytic_null_result.model: r_t = r_{t-1} + epsilon_t with iid zero-mean innovations of variance sigma2
analytic_null_result.implication: the proposed negative-reversion score is mechanically negative under the unit-root null before any bootstrap is applied

controlled_null_experiment.null: I(1) residual levels with iid or AR(1) increments and no stationary residual alpha by construction

interpretation: The sample-mean score itself has a negative null expectation for an iid random walk, so negative score does not identify stationarity or alpha.
Centering and resampling the score sequence does not impose the unit-root null on the residual level process.
The score-centered circular-block test therefore remains strongly oversized under an I(1) null even though it is dependence-aware at the score level.

A null-preserving bootstrap that reconstructs level paths under gamma=0 before computing an ADF-style statistic is near the nominal 10% size in these controlled cells and retains strong power with 336 observations for phi=0.90.
This is a synthetic calibration diagnostic, not a Polymarket false-discovery-rate or PnL estimate.
promotion_boundary: Do not treat PR #281 local-factor FDR survivors as calibrated alpha until marginal unit-root p-values are null-valid before BH/FDR.
